source_policy: Keep every S131 owner, direction, guessed net, gap, confidence, plays and reasoning unchanged. Re-emit only the curve layer from the market-condition shape described in the original S131 forecast record. Do not use this rehearsal as independent forecast evidence.
curve_contract: Frankie-selected event nodes with P25/P50/P75 cumulative-from-open envelope; no fixed cadence or point count
